snippet.title: JUBAKU | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
THE FIRST OFFICIAL TRAILER FOR JUBAKU IS HERE.

1991. Japan.

A journalist enters the Tanaka Residence to investigate a story.

What he finds inside will change everything.

JUBAKU is a first-person psychological thriller with branching choices and multiple endings.

🔴 THE JUBAKU DEMO ARRIVES SEPTEMBER 25, 2026.

Want to experience the Tanaka Residence for yourself?
